evidence: Implements wallet transaction rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and exposes it via a new RPC in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
rationale: Adds a direct RPC and GUI option to rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions that dropped from mempools. The change solves a clear user pain point, replacing the tedious workaround of manually extracting raw transaction hex and invoking sendrawtransaction, but is reasonably deferrable.
